# streamtime_fleet_configuration_profiles (Data Source)

Lists the places a fleet can run (fleet providers) and whether this organization can use each one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "streamtime_fleet_configuration_profiles" "all" {}

# Fleet providers this organization can use.
output "fleet_providers" {
  value = [for p in data.streamtime_fleet_configuration_profiles.all.profiles : p.identifier if p.enabled]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `profiles` (Attributes List) One entry per fleet provider. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--profiles))

<a id="nestedatt--profiles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `profiles`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) What the provider does.
- `disabled_reasons` (List of String) Why it cannot be used, when it is not enabled.
- `display_name` (String) Name shown in Streamtime.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this organization can create fleets with it.
- `identifier` (String) Value for a fleet's fleet_provider.
